versions.name: Search and Rescue
versions.description: Run a hasty search from planning through debrief: read maps and coordinates, predict how lost people behave, fit into an incident command structure, and treat what searchers and subjects suffer in the field.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
